X1.rule: Decision every Thursday close t (the fund's calendar: research/quant_trials/strategies.periods). For each ETF with >= 253 sessions of history: sign = +1 if AdjClose_t/AdjClose_{t-252} - 1 > 0 else -1; sigma = std of the last 63 daily Adj Close returns * sqrt(252); x = sign * 0.10 / sigma. If sum|x| > 2, scale all x down to sum|x| = 2. Held from close(t+1) to close(t2+1) as the fund. Cost 5 bp * sum|x_t - x_{t-1}|. No parameter search.
X1.standalone_returns: excess of cash: sum x_i (R_i - rf_period) - cost, rf = FRED DTB3 frozen in quant-tf cache, rf_period = rf * days/360
X1.development: first sleeve week .. 2019-12-31. Reported: Sharpe (excess, annualised from weekly), %/yr, vol, by year, correlation with SPY weekly excess return and with the development core's weekly excess return; also average gross and per-ETF contribution.
X1.core_development: the 1.3x/0.7x 200-day S&P rule on yfinance SPY Adj Close: s = 1.3 if AdjClose_t > its 200-session mean else 0.7; weekly return s*Rm - 5bp*|ds| - max(s-1,0)*(rf+2.43%)*days/360; excess = minus rf_period. Code check: on 2013-2019 weeks its raw return must correlate > 0.99 with research/sharpe/construct.py's core-only path (zero book) on the same weeks, else stop.
X1.weight: S_c, S_x (annualised excess Sharpe), rho, sigma_c, sigma_x on the common development weeks. Haircut S_x' = 0.5*S_x. Mean-variance optimum with the core at one unit: w = (sigma_c/sigma_x) * (S_x' - rho*S_c) / (S_c - rho*S_x'). This w maximises sqrt(S_c^2 + (S_x' - rho S_c)^2/(1 - rho^2)). If w <= 0 the sleeve gets weight 0 and X1 fails without a read. Reported: the combined Sharpe that formula predicts.
X1.gross_cap: Fund gross at t G_f = |s + w_spy| + sum|w_book| (about 1.9 when the core is at 1.3). Combined position = c_t * (fund + w * sleeve) with c_t = min(1, 1.9 / (G_f + w*sum|x|)) decided at t. Margin: the simulator's rule on the combined net long, max(c_t*(s + sum w_book + w_spy + w*sum x) - 1, 0) * (rf + 2.43%) * days/360; costs scale with c_t. The fund without the sleeve is B0 untouched. Combined raw weekly return measured as B0 is (raw, not excess), so B0 reproduces 21.7 %/yr and Sharpe 0.94.

test_2020_2025.lock: research/tree/L4_explore/READ_X1.lock, created before the first 2020-2025 sleeve return is computed
test_2020_2025.B0_check: my re-implementation of the S0 path (GROSS_SIDE 0.3, 5 bp, years 2020-2025) must give 21.7 %/yr and Sharpe 0.94 (OOS_RETURNS.json MASTER|gross 0.6|5bp) to 0.1 and 0.01, else stop before the read
test_2020_2025.test: paired weekly, with-sleeve scaled to B0's volatility; Ledoit-Wolf (2008) delta-method HAC test of the Sharpe difference, H1: Sharpe(with) > Sharpe(B0), one-sided; HAC = Bartlett kernel, lag floor(4(T/100)^(2/9)); (the paper's prewhitened QS kernel is not used; stated as a deviation). Holm across this branch's tested candidates (X1, and X2 only if it reaches a read) at alpha 0.05; the round-wide Holm is the coordinator's.
test_2020_2025.dsr: Deflated Sharpe Ratio (Bailey and Lopez de Prado 2014) of the with-sleeve fund: SR0 = sqrt(V)*((1-g)*Z^-1(1-1/N) + g*Z^-1(1-1/(N e))), g = 0.5772; V = 1/(T-1), the sampling variance of a zero-skill weekly Sharpe (trial Sharpes are not all on file); DSR = Phi((SR - SR0) sqrt(T-1) / sqrt(1 - skew*SR + (kurt-1)/4 SR^2)), weekly units. Must exceed 0.95. Sensitivity at N = 100 and 200 reported.
test_2020_2025.pass: Holm pass AND DSR > 0.95. A pass earns only a forward shadow from the first full week of December 2026 (instruments are owner policy: a proposal). Reported, not tested: %/yr, Sharpe, worst fall, by year, sleeve alone 2020-2025, the uncapped variant (descriptive).
